message.content: {"R1": {"parts": [{"snippet_ids": ["S5"], "text": "The frost alert is triggered when the orchard probe records two readings below 1°C at least ten minutes apart. A single low reading alone does not trigger it.","status": "supported", "request_span": "what triggers an alert"}, {"snippet_ids": ["S1"], "text": "The service sends a frost alert to the grower’s registered phone by text message. The dashboard stores a copy but does not substitute for the text.","status": "supported", "request_span": "where is it sent"}, {"snippet_ids": ["S3"], "text": "After receiving an alert, the grower is expected to inspect the irrigation valves before deciding whether to run sprinklers. The service does not turn the valves on.","status": "supported", "request_span": "what action is the grower expected to take"}]}}
